name: Pizzeria Hawaii
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Hawaii in Seefeld in Tirol** – Enjoy authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the Alps! Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our wood-fired pizzas bring the taste of Italy to the stunning backdrop of **Seefeld in Tirol**. Pair your meal with a cold **Radler** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** and soak in the mountain air. A must-visit for pizza lovers and those seeking a cozy escape after a day on the slopes. Opening hours: Mon–Thu: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM Fri–Sat: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM Sun: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM Specialties: – **Hawaii-Pizza** (ham, pineapple, mozzarella) – **Tiroler Käsekrainer** (local sausage, cheese, crispy onions) – **Veggie Delight** (mushrooms, zucchini, bell peppers, feta) Location: Hauptstraße 12, **Seefeld in Tirol** Just a short walk from the **Seefeld ski area** and **Rosshütte**. Good to know: – Free Wi-Fi – Outdoor seating with mountain views – Family-friendly with a kids' menu Reservations recommended: 📞 +43 5212 12345 📧 info@pizzeria-hawaii.at Come for the pizza, stay for the vibe! 🍕⛰️
